frame.note: 1 unit = 1 m; a hulking humanoid, soles on z = 0, the dragon head merged at HEAD_SHIFT above the neck

symmetry.policy: midline parts: right half authored, left half mirrored by name; limbs: right limb authored, left limb mirrored in x with R ↔ L renamed on the part and the slot; midline details use symmetric pins

bulk.doc: x scale of the torso and arms about the mirror plane (broader chest, the arms ride outward with it)

gut.doc: metres the belly front slots move forward at the waist

stance.doc: x scale of the legs about the mirror plane (wider stance, thicker legs)

clawLength.doc: stretch of every claw along its own axis

skullWidth.doc: x scale of the skull stations, blended out along the snout

snoutLength.doc: y scale of the snout stations about the eye station

browDrop.doc: metres the brow slots drop at the crown, eye and root stations

jawOpen.doc: degrees the jaw part rotates about its hinge slot (front goes down)

lean.doc: degrees the torso, arms, neck and head hinge forward about the pelvis tip; the legs stay planted

tailCurl.doc: degrees per tail joint about x, propagated from the base (+ lifts the tip)

tailSway.doc: degrees per tail joint about z, propagated from the base (+ swings the tip to the right)

grip.doc: degrees per finger joint, both hands, curling toward the palm
